subject: MAP: reprofiled close-runway & contingency note — Acme-X evaluation
messages:

Subject: MAP update — potential close slip (Acme-X evaluation)

Can you circulate a reprofiled runway and an updated risk register today? Also copying procurement so they see the potential shift.

Thanks,
Jordan

Acme-X

Jordan — thanks for the heads up. I put together an initial reprofile (attached) and a short runbook for a 2-week procurement bridge if the cert delay pushes past July 31. Key asks for you: confirm the internal cert ETA and whether payment term flexibility is possible.

Internal note for Marissa/Ben: please review the attached MAP_v3 and the risk register I sketched. If we need SLA credit language we should surface it now so legal can triage.

Planned next steps:
- Marissa to validate performance gating and canary window adjustments (due EOD 7/20)
- Ben to confirm dedicated capacity allocation change and cost delta (due 7/21)
- I'll coordinate procurement ask with Karthik and capture escalation triggers

Attachments: AcmeX_MAP_v3.xlsx, risk_log_acmex_v1.csv

Best,
Neha Kapoor

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-20T15:22:00Z
Subject: Re: MAP update — potential close slip (Acme-X evaluation)

Looping in a couple of quick checks after reviewing MAP_v3 and the risk sheet:

- Performance gating: recommend expanding canary from 24h -> 72h with a rolling rollout across 3 test accounts; that cushions for variability in Acme's burst.
- KV cache expectation: we can enable prefix caching for the eval corpus to cut token cost during the extended window. That will save ~18% unit cost during canary.
- Risk register: added two rows (attached) for "cert gating" and "procurement hold" with owners.

I've attached risk_log_acmex_v1.csv with the updates — accept or flag additions. If Ben confirms the burst carve-out, we can commit to the 2-week bridge.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Reliability | Redwood Inference

Attachments: risk_log_acmex_v1.csv

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-21T09:04:00Z
Subject: Re: MAP update — potential close slip (Acme-X evaluation)

We can commit a temporary carve (2 GPUs) for the extended eval window with the following caveats:
- Cost delta estimated: +$3,400/week (will refine once we know utilization)
- Requires procurement sign-off for any billing term adjustments
- We can enable the prefix cache suggestion; ops will apply that Thursday 7/22 night window

I added a short note in the risk file about the cost delta. Karthik — can you advise on typical procurement bridge language and how quickly we can get a PO amendment?

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Sr. Product Ops Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-21T14:18:00Z
Subject: Re: MAP update — potential close slip (Acme-X evaluation)

Ben/Team — procurement can typically issue a short-term amendment for evaluation extends (one-week increments) with a simple e-sign addendum. For Acme-X: if they confirm the cert delay window by EOD 7/21 we can arrange a 7–14 day amendment and invoice pro-rata.

Notes for the MAP: add an "escalation trigger" section that calls for an exec sync if cert delay > 10 business days and include who owns the legal/finance touchpoints. I'll draft the procurement addendum today and share a DocuSign link.

Karthik Iyer
Director, Commercial Ops | Redwood Inference

On another note, forwarding procurement's note below for context:

Jordan

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>

Date: 2028-07-22T17:34:00Z
Subject: Re: MAP: reprofiled close-runway & contingency note — Acme-X evaluation

Jordan — appreciate the clarity and the ask from your CFO. Summary and agreed actions below (new MAP_v3 attached with highlighted changes):

1) Re-baselined close: target close moved from 2028-07-31 -> 2028-08-14 (contingency window to 2028-08-21 if procurement confirms later ETA).
2) Temporary capacity carve: 2 GPUs for the evaluation bridge; Ben estimated cost delta ~$3.4k/week; Ben/ops to invoice pro-rata.
3) Procurement amendment: Karthik to send DocuSign addendum for 7–14 day extension; procurement to confirm cert ETA by 7/22 EOD.
4) SLA concession ask: we'll review the 30% credit / 30-day extension tradeoff — Neha to own exec approval path; target decision by 7/25 EOD.
5) Escalation trigger: autoplan an exec sync if cert delay > 10 business days from 7/20 (owner: Neha); legal and finance copied as required.

I'll open a support ticket for SLA exception routing and drop the DocuSign link into the MAP once Karthik shares it. Please reply only for any edits to the MAP or changes to the procurement ETA — otherwise I'll treat this as the agreed runway and begin the exec briefing draft.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference
